description: Project-authored summaries; documentation only. Review relevance against the incident kernel revision.

documents.text: KASAN is a dynamic detector of invalid memory accesses. Use-after-free and out-of-bounds are different failure modes. Inspect the reported access and available allocation/free stacks before asserting the mechanism. A sanitizer signature identifies an observed violation; a verified reproducer or code review is needed for an exact causal claim.

Lockdep tracks locking dependencies to identify potential deadlocks. A reported circular dependency indicates a possible problematic ordering; it is not by itself proof that the captured execution actually deadlocked. Compare lock acquisition order and context.

LKDTM intentionally triggers kernel failures for testing exception handling and crash dumping. Available actions depend on the kernel build; query the debugfs DIRECT interface. PANIC and OVERFLOW are example trigger types. A test-trigger message can disclose the injected mechanism and should be tracked as possible benchmark label leakage.
